summary: Added a `show_speed` parameter (default False) to `TaskProgressColumn` in rich/progress.py. When the task has no total and show_speed is True, the column appends the speed as "X.XX it/s" using the existing `task.speed` property, or "? it/s" when the speed is not yet known, styled with the existing `progress.data.speed` style. The constructor stores it as `self.show_speed` and the class docstring now documents its arguments. Nothing was run or tested, per the instructions; the change was checked only by reading the code. No tests, docs, or changelog were updated, and nothing was committed.
